name: Hairline
freeTier: Some tools are free to use. Hairline Pro unlocks the rest, as listed on our pricing table.
description: Hairline runs in your browser; changes it makes to web pages are visible only to you and reset when you reload.
activate: Paste it into Hairline → Settings → Activate Pro.
move: You can move it between browsers by deactivating one in Settings.
licenceCheck: Hairline checks your licence with our licence server about once a day. It keeps working offline for up to 14 days.
afterRefund: Your licence key is deactivated and Pro tools lock again. The free tools keep working.
acceptableUse: Don't use Hairline to copy or republish content, designs or code you don't have permission to use.
thirdParties: Send to AI only prepares a prompt and opens the AI app you choose (such as Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini); your use of those apps is governed by their own terms and privacy policies. Font previews may load fonts from Google Fonts.
